prompt: A contact sheet of six separate food photographs arranged in a strict grid of 3 columns by 2 rows, each subject centred in its own invisible square cell of equal size (cells are 768 by 768 px), on one continuous seamless flat matte warm cream ground (#F4E6C4), with no lines, borders or labels between cells and a generous empty margin (at least 12 percent) around each subject so nothing touches a cell edge. All six shot identically: three-quarter elevated angle (about 40 degrees), soft warm daylight from the upper left, very soft short contact shadow under each item, the same sharp realistic editorial food-photography look, real appetising colours. Crockery: matte deep forest-green (#233929) and off-white ceramic, brushed steel, no printing on anything. The reference image only shows the look of the bowl, light and food realism: do not copy its composition or ground colour. Cells, left to right, top row then bottom row: (1) poulet tikka: three skewers of marinated orange-red chicken tikka with charred edges, on a steel plate with lemon wedge and a few red onion rings; (2) a cookie au chocolat au lait: a thick golden-brown cookie with melting milk-chocolate chunks, one bite taken, with a second cookie behind it; (3) pakora: four round golden fried potato fritters on a small steel plate, with a little green chutney in a tiny bowl; (4) samosa chaat: a crushed vegetable samosa topped with chickpeas, chopped red onion, white yoghurt, red and green chutney and a pinch of fresh coriander, in a shallow green bowl; (5) raita: a small green ceramic bowl of white yoghurt with grated cucumber and carrot, a pinch of cumin and a mint leaf; (6) soupe de lentilles: a green bowl of thick golden-orange lentil soup topped with fresh coriander and a few fenugreek leaves, a spoon resting beside it. Absolutely no text, no letters, no logos, no printed packaging, no hands, no people. Original images, not copies of any brand's photos.
